name: Tsubaki Tsuneko
source:
Get ready for being pierced by glaring looks, snarky remarks and rolling eyes. Some would say she's a walking land mine, others she's a machine gun. Tsuneko is for sure a beauty, but she certainly has no heart - or does she?

Favorite sweets: too cute to tell!

[From [url=https://thelastsecret.itch.io/dere-quartet]itch.io[/url]]
